title: Parking License Schedule of Monthly Fees and Activation Charges
content:
Each Parking License product carries its own monthly license fee, a one-time activation fee charged when the license starts, and a storage bundle rate. The figures below apply per license, one vehicle per license.

## Schedule of charges by parking product

| Parking product | Monthly license fee | First license on the lease carries no monthly fee | Activation fee | Storage bundle rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | $25.00 | Yes | $0.00 | 0% |
| Surface Reserved Space | $45.00 | No | $25.00 | 0% |
| Covered Carport Space | $65.00 | No | $25.00 | 10% |
| Structured Garage Space | $95.00 | No | $35.00 | 10% |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | $125.00 | No | $50.00 | 10% |
| Private Detached Garage | $235.00 | No | $50.00 | 15% |

The storage bundle rate is the product's discount rate on the monthly fee while the lease also holds an active Storage Rental.

## Posting and price-holding terms (identical for every product)

| Term | Figure for every Parking License product |
|---|---|
| Day of the month the monthly fee posts | the 1st |
| Proration of the first and last month | by the actual days in the month |
| Months the monthly fee is held after the license starts | 12 |
| Written notice before a monthly fee increase after that hold | 30 calendar days |

## Reading the schedule

- **Which products are included without a monthly fee?** Only the Surface Unreserved Permit is marked as carrying no monthly fee for the first license of that product on a lease; every other product shows "No".
- **Which products charge nothing at activation?** Only the Surface Unreserved Permit, whose activation fee is $0.00.
- **Which products carry a storage bundle rate above zero?** Covered Carport Space, Structured Garage Space and EV Charging Reserved Space at 10%, and Private Detached Garage at 15%; the two surface products show 0%.
